trust_decision.summary: Untrusted HTML script text is trusted only when it is about to be written: every `<` in the re-serialized JSON is rewritten to \u003C at the JSON arm that assigns the script text node, not in the shared JSON serializer and not in the HTML code generator.

landing_point.why: The report names the HTML minifier and embedded JSON; the only place JSON is serialized back into a script element's text is the MinifierType::Json arm of visit_mut_text.

fix_sites.entry_point: swc_html_minifier::minify_document / minify_document_fragment (via MinifyCss-generic *_with_custom_css_minifier, also wrapped by binding_html_node and binding_html_wasm)
private helper escape_json_for_html_script, reached only from the JSON arm above
fix_sites.module_kind: html minifier core (private helper next to minify_json)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: crates/swc_ecma_codegen/src/lit.rs:221-251 (replace_close_inline_script, gated by Config::inline_script at crates/swc_ecma_codegen/src/config.rs:46) is the general implementation of the same protection; the HTML minifier never enables it and instead does its own exact-match replace at crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2084-2089

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The JS path already guards the element terminator itself (crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2087), so a solver reads 'JSON only' and leaves that path alone: its own guard is a neighbouring feature's code, its gaps (case-insensitive end tag, whitespace-terminated end tag) are pre-existing behaviour nobody reported, and the general helper lives in another crate.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: JavaScript text in the same <script> sink legitimately keeps literal `<` -- the project's own fixture output still contains alert("<!--") after minification (crates/swc_html_minifier/tests/fixture/element/script/output.min.html:30) -- so the escape must stay inside the JSON arm; applied at the sink level (or to JS output) it rewrites valid JS, where `<` is an operator that \u003C would not replace.

type attribute matched after ASCII lowercasing and trimming, so TYPE=" Application/JSON " also reaches the JSON arm (crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2655-2657)

custom script types mapped to json through minifyAdditionalScriptsContent (crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2679-2687; fixture crates/swc_html_minifier/tests/fixture/element/custom-script-type/config.json:5)
any serde_json::Value shape (object, array, bare scalar) with '<' in a key or in a string value, at any nesting depth (fix.diff:31-37)
script elements in the HTML and SVG namespaces (crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2646-2649)
JSON minified into an attribute value through minifyAdditionalAttributes (crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2453-2457) -- handled by neither the old nor the new code

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JS text arm: minified JS is written back to the same <script> text node after only an exact-case `</script>` string replace, so an end tag reconstructed from escapes ("\u003C/SCRIPT>", "</script\u0020>", "</script/>") survives into the output unescaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The JS path already has its own `</script>` guard (crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2087), and the advisory is about embedded JSON, so the JS string-literal route is treated as a different, already-handled feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different function (minify_js vs. the JSON arm); the correct helper for it lives in another package, crates/swc_ecma_codegen/src/lit.rs:221-251

O8_uncovered_routes.route: minifyAdditionalScriptsContent can map a script type to `html`; the inner HTML minifier's serialized output is then written raw into the outer <script> text (visit_mut_text, MinifierType::Html arm) with no terminator guard, so inner markup can synthesise a `</script>` terminator in the outer element.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only reachable with an explicit minifyAdditionalScriptsContent mapping of a non-standard type (the repo itself maps text/html -> html in crates/swc_html_minifier/tests/fixture/element/script-custom-type/config.json:7), so it reads as an expert opt-in config rather than the documented JSON path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: escape the JSON written into an attribute value (minifyAdditionalAttributes -> MinifierType::Json) when that value is later inlined into a script
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same minify_json serializer feeds the attribute sink, so a maintainer adding or reviewing JSON attribute support copies the sibling helper call one screen up.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: route the JS terminator handling through swc_ecma_codegen::lit::replace_close_inline_script / Config::inline_script instead of the exact-match string replace
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the comment right above it already asks for exactly that ('TODO move it to ecma codegen under the option?', crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs:2086).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an analogous terminator escape for CSS text serialized by the CSS minifier into a <style> element
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same match on the same text sink; a maintainer writing 'serialized output must not terminate its containing element' would naturally cover style next to script.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a post-processing escape of the final HTML string in the node/wasm binding wrapper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the bindings already wrap minify_inner and are the layer that hands bytes back to JS consumers, so a security-conscious maintainer could add a belt-and-braces pass there instead of in the crate.
